Southern Miss ranks 135th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 26:46, compared to South Alabama's 25th-ranked average of 31:49. Martin, 639 yards on 142 carries, 7 TDs Receiving: Brendan Jenkins, 568 yards on 35 catches, 3 TDs Southern Miss Passing: Landry Lyddy, 1,326 yards, 8 TDs, 4 INTs, 57.7 completion percentage Rushing: Steven Robinson, 876 yards on 174 carries, 10 TDs Receiving: Mario Sanders II, 817 yards on 58 catches, 7 TDs Last game South Alabama defeated Troy 27-14 on Nov. 14.
